svg.text: PR #2206 · Route session-scoped network access through a PortalClient
Session UI built every URL from window.location, so it could only reach one portal.
Now each SessionView provides a PortalClient context its whole subtree resolves against.
BEFORE
AFTER
utils::get_base_url / api_url / ws_url
Read window.location on every call: the origin
that served the page is the only reachable portal.
Session subtree, each call site on its own
SessionView history, turn-metrics, edit-stack, plugins
connect_websocket, ForwardChips, ForwardSurface
ShareDialog, ForkDialog, VoiceInput transcribe
PortalFileLink, ImageViewer / VideoViewer src
Raw relative paths bypass api_url entirely
fork POST, file pull, /api/images and /api/media src:
no single seam to point a session at another origin.
PortalClient (portal_client.rs)
url, ws_url, resolve, get/post/patch/delete, fetch_json.
App root provides PortalClient::home() as context.
SessionViewProps.portal re-provides the context
SessionView calls use props.portal; connect_websocket
takes it. Descendants read use_portal() (function
components) or portal_from_context (struct ones).
ForwardChips refetches when the portal changes too.
resolve(): root-relative refs land on the session portal
Absolute and data: URLs pass through; today every
session is on home, so behavior is unchanged.
Refactor only. Rail actions, the session list, settings/admin and markdown image src stay on home helpers; bearer auth and per-portal keys come later.
